title: Persistent Combinatorial Model of the Restricted Second Configuration Space of Metric Star Graphs
summary: In this work, we present explicit constructions and computations of representative cycles for a nontrivial 2-parameter persistence module arising from the configuration space of metric star graphs. For all edge-length vector $\mathbf{L}=(L_1, L_2, \dots, L_k)\in(\mathbb{R}_{>0})^k$, we construct a bipartite weighted graph $(G_k)_{\mathbf{L}}$ and define filtering functions on the set of vertices and set of edges of $(G_k)_{\mathbf{L}}$ to obtain a filtration (denoted by $(G_k)_{-,\mathbf{L}}$) consisting of geometric realization of subgraphs of $(G_k)_{\mathbf{L}}$.
